title: Altar of Fangs PUG baseline for +10 to +15

pulls.notes: Use Bloodlust if planned, soothe or briefly control the Descendants' Ravenous Claws, interrupt Piercing Hiss, and remove Paralyzing Shots.
Keep this separate from the opening pull for the PUG baseline; stop Piercing Hiss and give the tank room to reset Descendant attack-speed pressure.
Rotate Serpent kicks, clear the Chieftain's group healing absorb, and use a tank defensive for its heavy physical hit.
The six Descendants make this a tank-control check: stagger AoE stops and kiting while the group activates the required opening-area totems.
Finish the remaining required totem interactions, interrupt both Serpents, and avoid adding the nearby Harrowers before this pack is controlled.
Chain this after the prior pack rather than combining it by default; remove Paralyzing Shots and dodge the Harrowers' rotating breath.
After Ravenous Stomp, move Rav'i to an empty Carrion Pile, break the feeding shield, spread for Triple Shot, and dodge Regurgitate.
Hard-control Evolve, interrupt the Evolutionists, dispel Envenom, and use a defensive for the Rattling Writhe's Corrosive Fangs.
Commit cooldowns to the large Bloodletter pack, reserve hard control for Evolve, and keep moving out of pools as the fixating enemies are cleaved.
Interrupt each Toxic Atrophy, have every living player run away together to break Death Rattle, dodge Burrowing Charge and Venom Jet, then control the Uncoiled Writhes.
The Ascendant Serpent is a progression gate: hard-control every Evolve, group its fixating Hatchlings, stack tornado drops, and avoid overpulling extra Blades.
Interrupt Mass Envenom, dodge Toxic Surge, and stagger Living Venom deaths so their explosions do not overlap while the tank manages the Blades.
Assign Piercing Hiss kicks, remove Paralyzing Shots, and let the tank establish the stair pack before the group closes in.
Handle the double-Chieftain and Chosen pressure before the final fight; on Zul'jan, preassign all four beam lanes and use Boneslicer at the edge to clear Ritual Venom.

provenance.description: Original WHELP transcription and normalization of Skandar Tank Altar of Fangs revision 4. Keystone.guru flags the route as using an older mapping; the visible route has fourteen meaningful enemy slots plus one empty placeholder and totals 832/817.

The public MDT2 export was decoded only as reconciliation evidence. Its eighth slot retains two High Evolutionist clone references while the rendered route visibly counts three; WHELP preserves the rendered three-enemy count and therefore leaves the route draft.
Pull notes and boss checkpoints are original compact summaries corroborated against Wowhead's updated Patch 12.1 Altar of Fangs overview.
Current NPC identifiers, encounters, and per-unit enemy-forces values reconciled against installed Mythic Dungeon Tools 6.2.10 and DBM Dungeons r261 Retail data.
